sentences.text: Petitioner had filed a complaint alleging offences under Sections 406, 420, 463 and 471 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The said complaint was referred by the learned Magistrate for investigation to the police and thereafter Crime No.4798 of 2014 was registered before the Aluva East Police Station.

After completing the investigation, the police filed a report stating that further action has to be dropped, since the alleged forgery was in respect of a document produced before the court and in the absence of a complaint by the court, the proceedings cannot be pursued in view of the bar under Section 195 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Pursuant to the report of the police, petitioner preferred a protest complaint and by order dated 27.10.2021, the learned Magistrate refused to take cognizance.

Challenging the refusal to take cognizance, Crl.M.C.No.866 of 2023 was preferred by the petitioner before this Court and by order dated 09.03.2023, the order of the learned Magistrate dated 27.10.2022 was set aside after observing that the restriction under Section 195(1)(b)(ii) of Cr.P.C. will be attracted only in respect of documents where the forgery was committed after production in court CRL.MC NO. 10371 OF 2023 and not in relation to documents which were subjected to forgery, prior to its production.
Thereafter, the learned Magistrate while considering the protest complaint took cognizance of the case as C.C.No.1042 of 2023 by order dated 23.09.2022.
Petitioner challenges the order taking cognizance.
3. Sri

.John Sebastian Ralph V., the learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the final report submitted by the police concluded by saying that the further action ought to be dropped in view of the purported restriction under Section 195 of Cr.P.C.

According to the learned counsel, once this Court had set aside the order refusing to take cognizance, necessarily the Magistrate ought to have ordered further investigation on the basis of the protest complaint.
This was essential in view of the nature of allegations especially since forgery is alleged.

According to the learned counsel, without a proper investigation by the police, it will be practically difficult to prove the allegations of forgery and therefore the learned Magistrate erred in taking cognizance.
4. I have heard Smt.Sreeja V., the learned Public Prosecutor as well.
5. The earlier investigation culminated in a report stating that further action is to be dropped in view of the restriction under Section 195(1)(a)(b) Cr.P.C.

By Annexure A5, this Court had set aside the Joseph P.V vs State Of Kerala on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113029559/
2 order of the learned Magistrate refusing to take cognizance of the offence on the basis of the restriction under Section 195 Cr.P.C. since it was found CRL.MC NO. 10371 OF 2023 that the documents were allegedly forged even prior to its production before court.

sentences.text: 6. The nature of allegations in the complaint indicate that an investigation by police is necessary.
However, by taking cognizance of the offence, the learned Magistrate is calling upon the petitioner to adduce the necessary evidence to prove the forgery.
The nature of offences alleged, indicate that a police investigation is essential.

Since the only reason for dropping further action in the earlier final report was due to the bar under Section 195 of Cr.P.C. and as it has been held that such a restraint is inapplicable to the present case, it would have been appropriate that the learned Magistrate referred the matter for further investigation.
7. However, referring the matter for further investigation can be done only at the pre-cognizance stage and not after taking cognizance.
Therefore, in order to enable the learned Magistrate to reconsider the matter, the order taking cognizance needs to be set aside.
Accordingly, I set aside the order dated 23.09.2023 in C.M.P.No.1715 of 2015 and direct the learned Judicial First Class Magistrate, Aluva to consider the same in accordance with law.
The Crl.M.C.is allowed as above.
